data.title: EvalCards: A Framework for Standardized Evaluation Reporting
data.description: arXiv:2511.21695v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Evaluation reports guide the use of general-purpose AI (GPAI) models, yet inconsistent reporting often leaves essential questions unanswered. Through a review of prior work, we identify three central issues in evaluation reporting practices today, reproducibility, accessibility, and accountability, and examine how existing reporting artifacts fall short in addressing them. We introduce the EvalCards framework, outlining its key dimensions and presenting a preliminary format for concise evaluation summaries. We conclude by discussing how the framework can guide the future development of evaluation reporting standards.
data.author: Ruchira Dhar, Danae Sanchez Villegas, Antonia Karamolegkou, Alice Schiavone, Yifei Yuan, Xinyi Chen, Jiaang Li, Stella Frank, Laura De Grazia, Monorama Swain, Stephanie Brandl, Daniel Hershcovich, Anders S{\o}gaard, Desmond Elliott
